sloka: चतुरंग समायुक्तम् मया सह च तम् नय ।षष्टिः वर्ष सहस्राणि जातस्य मम कौशिक ॥१-२०-१०॥
transliteration: caturaṁga samāyuktam mayā saha ca tam naya ।ṣaṣṭiḥ varṣa sahasrāṇi jātasya mama kauśika ॥1-20-10॥

translations.english: O scion of of Kusika family, sixty thousand years have passed since I was born. Rama was born to me after a great deal of suffering. It is not proper to take him with you.
translations.hindi: मुझसे रक्षित हो वे अपने दिव्य तेज से मेरे यज्ञ क्री रक्षा करेंगे और विन्नकारी राक्षसों को भी नष्ट करेंगे
